captions.text: Smart context adds what Maya’s new chat needs, as she types.
In a fresh ChatGPT chat, Maya asks for help with her PearX interview.
The blue line says what goes with it: her earlier prep chat, and the AIs she had it with.
The list shows all of it: the chat, who she is, and what she knows about PearX and Tidepool.
Add memory searches her memory. The top four show, and what matches lights up.
Ask Cori takes it in her own words, and adds the notes she meant.
One Enter puts it all in front of her draft and sends. ChatGPT starts from the work she already did.
In another chat she brings up her side project.
Coere adds who she is and what it knows about SkipDoodle.
Then she asks a follow up in the same chat.
Nothing new goes with it. ChatGPT already has it.
Later, asking about the stack brings SkipDoodle’s tech stack back.
For a long context, Dev Tools has File Upload (beta).
With it on, a context longer than the number she sets goes as a text file. A short one stays as text.
Her PearX prep chat makes this context long.
One Enter attaches it as coere-context.txt, puts a short note in front of her draft, and sends once.
What goes is always on the line above the box, to change before she sends.
